content: Enable Banking: restricted production mode (link own accounts) free for personal non-commercial use per ToS; consent length capped by ASPSP max (usually 180d); ~4 background fetches/day when PSU absent; re-auth creates new session and account ids, match via identification_hash; entry_reference only reliable for booked tx; transaction_id unstable. GoCardless BAD new signups closed: secondary sources only (MEDIUM/LOW).
